author: KC Reporter
title: Khiry Shelton emphasizes community engagement alongside soccer career
text:
Children's Mercy Park | Sporting Kansas City
Children's Mercy Park | Sporting Kansas City
In the world of soccer, Khiry Shelton stands out not just for his on-field performance but also for his off-field contributions. A seasoned Major League Soccer player with experience abroad, Shelton is redefining the role of a modern athlete through community engagement and personal mentorship.
Shelton expresses a strong sense of purpose beyond soccer. "I think there's a bigger picture to a lot of what I do and what we do as a collective," he states. He emphasizes the importance of mutual support between athletes and their communities: "We have people come out and support us. We need that support. And we also want to be able to support them as well. Any way we can."
His involvement in Kansas City's community is significant, though understated. When asked about his favorite community event, Shelton finds it difficult to choose one over another, stating, “Every one. Every single one. I don't have a favorite... they’re all special.”
As an experienced player on Sporting Kansas City, Shelton also mentors younger teammates adjusting to professional life after college or academy experiences. He acknowledges their challenges: "They have to take on life’s challenges, juggling and finding a routine that balances and flows with their life so that they can perform at their highest level possible.”
In addition to guidance on the field, Shelton shares cultural experiences such as music with teammates like Mason Toye during van rides to preseason training—introducing them to what younger players like Ian James humorously call “old school” music from artists like Drake.
Shelton's commitment extends beyond mentoring; it reflects in personal aspects like his tattoos, which are chosen thoughtfully over years: “They're all sentimental,” he says about them.
Raised by parents who influenced him differently—his mother was an avid reader while his father served in the military—Shelton embodies dual traits: introspection and competitive spirit.
For Shelton, family plays an essential role in finding peace. His daughter is central to this sentiment: “She’s a very bright light... she definitely lights up the room.” As her father, he aims to instill values such as boldness and bravery.
